_doc: Single source of size/freshness budgets for every AI-context layer. Read by context-health.mjs (via context-config.mjs) and quoted by /update-knowledge and the wiki/playbook/track specs. Its presence marks the repo as a context-loop instance. Bytes unless stated. soft = WARN, hard = BROKEN.

canonical._files: Budget per auto-loaded canonical file. An exact path wins; otherwise the first matching glob in key order (* matches one path segment). The apps/* and packages/* patterns are examples that /context init rewrites to this repo's workspace roots; add an exact-path entry to give one workspace a different budget.
canonical._optionalWorkspaces: workspaces that need no CLAUDE.md: config packages, and libraries whose canon is a wiki subsystem page or a sibling's CLAUDE.md

versionClaims._doc: Root CLAUDE.md tech-stack rows checked against the installed majors. Each check: { "label": regex on the row text with the major in group 1, e.g. "React (\\d+)", "dep": package name, e.g. "react", "from": workspace package.json that declares it, e.g. "apps/web/package.json" }.

agents._surfaces: path prefixes per dev agent (one key per .claude/agents/<agent>.md that keeps a playbook), e.g. { "web-dev": ["apps/web/"], "core-dev": ["packages/core/"] }. knowledge-recall.mjs --surface/--candidates uses them to pick episodic records on that agent's surface.
